scope: Three same-resolved-URL, same format 251 paired decoder-route observations; independent access validation precedes each arm; no end-to-end startup, audible-output, catalog/acoustic or production qualification.

provenance.binaryHashVerification: Supplied by root; not independently rehashed while the next live benchmark was running.
provenance.buildSourceCaveat: After compilation, lib.rs library declaration ordering/formatting changed. Root reports all implementation bodies match commit 96fc8c9. The compiled binary is not claimed to represent a byte-identical snapshot of the later whole working tree.

timingDefinitions.firstPcmFromArmMs: Begins after common resolution; equals this arm access validation plus this arm decoder route through first PCM. Each arm has its own access validation.
timingDefinitions.decoderFirstPcmMs: PCM sub-result firstPcmMs, after arm access validation; legacy includes its failed native setup and FFmpeg fallback.
timingDefinitions.commonResolutionMs: Resolved once per pair and shared by both routes; reported separately, not an independently repeated resolver arm.
timingDefinitions.pairedDeltaSign: direct-ffmpeg minus legacy-native-probe; negative favors the direct arm in these observations.
timingDefinitions.noFullStartupMetric: No total startup value is synthesized by adding shared resolution to the sequential arm measurements. Device/mixer, queue, app startup and catalog selection are not measured.

pairs.audibility: not measured by a physical device
near-silent excerpt in both arms; audibility not established
not measured by a physical device

pairedFirstPcmFromArmDeltaMs.interpretation: Observed within-pair route timing only; n=3 across different source IDs, with one pair per source. No population p95 or universal latency claim.

pcmScope.sampleEqualityCaveat: Equal frame count and RMS do not establish byte-identical waveforms, recording equivalence, or audibility.
pcmScope.posoCaveat: The first five-second Poso excerpt is near-silent in both arms (RMS about 6.8e-6). PCM production must not be equated with audible playback; this observation alone does not imply wrong recording.

limitations: All three legacy arms report a decoder_setup failed native attempt before FFmpeg; direct arms skip that attempt. Other per-arm I/O/access differences remain.
Independent access checks and sequential execution can vary; connection/HTTP client state is reused, and AB/BA/AB does not remove every order or source confound.
No physical device, mixer timing, audible-output assertion, resource-accounting comparison or full-recording test is present in this paired log.
The next larger live cohort is separate and is not included or pooled into this three-pair summary.
Zero FFmpeg byte counters in the decoder telemetry do not measure zero network transfer; no transferred-byte comparison is available here.
